meta.title: About LipoNexus | UC San Diego Spinout Bringing Root-Cause MASLD Diagnostics to Practitioners
meta.description: LipoNexus is a UC San Diego spinout commercializing the first accurate non-invasive blood test for Fatty Liver Disease, built on decades of NIH-funded lipidomics research and validated in 500+ patients.

hero.headline: Giving Functional Medicine Practitioners the Test They've Been Missing
hero.body: LipoNexus is commercializing the first best-in-class blood test for Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD/MASH) — a tool built specifically for practitioners who want to identify and treat metabolic dysfunction at its root cause. Co-founded by UC San Diego professors and physicians who are world leaders in Lipidomics and Hepatology, our technology is the product of decades of NIH investment and rigorous clinical science.

mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.body: To equip functional medicine and integrative health practitioners with the most accurate, accessible, and actionable diagnostic tools for Fatty Liver Disease and metabolic-associated conditions — enabling earlier intervention, personalized treatment, and measurably better patient outcomes.

approach.headline: Decades of NIH Investment Behind Our Technology
approach.body: The LipoNexus test was developed by the founder of the field of Lipidomics and is the product of decades of NIH-funded research. Our 15-lipid panel directly measures disease-causing inflammatory lipid biomarkers — the root cause of MASLD — using commercial clinical laboratories and mass spectrometry.

points.title: $77M NIH Grant (2003–2013)
points.description: Established the field of Lipidomics via a National Institutes of Health 'Glue Grant' (U54 GM069338) for LIPID Metabolites And Pathways Strategy (LIPID MAPS®) — a multi-institutional initiative for detection, identification, and classification of all biological lipids.

points.title: $2M NIH Grant (2018–2024)
points.description: NIH Grant NIDDK 5 R01 DK105961 — 'Lipidomics Based Diagnostics for Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis.' Lipidomics analysis of 2,000 biopsied patient samples from the NIDDK Biobank for development of MASLD and MASH diagnostics.

points.title: Clinical Validation
points.description: 500-patient clinical study published in October 2024. Current test IP filed in 2024 with 6 patents total (3 issued, 3 filed). 95%+ accuracy and 99% specificity validated against histological ground truth (liver biopsy).

points.title: Regulatory Pathway
points.description: Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) launch Q2 2026 — validation and verification in a CLIA lab. FDA-approved test targeted for 2027. Widespread clinician adoption 2028+ driven by hepatology clinical guideline recommendations.

items.title: Root-Cause Science
items.description: Every claim is backed by data — from $77M in NIH-funded lipidomics research to a 500-patient published clinical study. We measure what's actually driving disease.

items.title: Patient Impact
items.description: Only 10% of people with Fatty Liver Disease are diagnosed. We exist to change that — by giving practitioners the tools to identify and reverse MASLD before it progresses.

items.title: Proactive, Preventive Medicine
items.description: MASLD is fully reversible when caught early. We build tools for practitioners who believe in getting ahead of disease — not just managing it after the damage is done.

items.title: Practitioner Partnership
items.description: We partner directly with functional medicine and integrative health practitioners to ensure LipoNexus testing is accessible, actionable, and meaningful in clinical practice.
